{{Quote|You have to be alert every second on Mimban. This is a crazy world, where the ground itself is your most uncertain enemy.|Halla|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Mimban''', formally known as '''Circarpous V''',<ref name="CSWE" /> was the home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Coway]], the [[Mimbanite]]s, and the extinct [[Thrella]]. Although originally named Circarpous V, the planet was never colonized by the Circarpousians. The planet, locally known as Mimban, was in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]].

==Geographic features==
Mimban was a cloud-covered jungle world that was largely unexplored. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] over Mimban was very turbulent. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] without special hulls faced tremendous danger from the energy storms that streaked the stratosphere. The surface of the planet was damp, and the perpetual mist made it difficult to distinguish night from day.

==History==
While the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] kept the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in suspense, a famed [[Mandalorian]] warrior offered a substantial reward to anyone who was able to determine the identity of a masked opponent he fought to a draw during a battle on Circarpous V in order to challenge the rival to a rematch.<ref name="Round2">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Round Two}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Early in the war, a unit of the [[224th]] known as the [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud-Jumpers]]<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> and a unit of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] known as the [[Devil Dogs]] served on the planet and fought in the [[Battle of Mimban/Legends|Battle of Mimban]].<ref name="The Clone Wars 7">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref>

[[Haka Hai]] had a base on the planet. It was here that he [[Skirmish on Mimban|attempted]] to take [[Dreypa's Oubliette]] from the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]''. He later died when [[Bomo Greenbark]] ambushed Hara and his men after Bomo escaped captivity.<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Times Volume Two—Parallels">''[[Star Wars: Dark Times Volume 2—Parallels]]''</ref>

With [[thaissen crystal]]s acquired from Mimban and techniques adapted from lightsaber construction, Lord [[Cronal]] gave the [[Force detector]]s the ability to magnify any Force detected, as well as sense dark-side tendencies in the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] subject.

At the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control of the planet was entrusted to [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]], who ruled from the Imperial planetary headquarters built into an ancient towering ziggurat.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the planet environment was devastated.<ref name="TEA" /> The Galactic Empire used Mimban as the site for an Imperial energy mining operation. This consisted of five makeshift mining towns, all run by Imperials at the height of their operations.

The legendary [[Kaiburr crystal]] was located deep in the jungle within the [[Temple of Pomojema]]. The powerful crystal rested within a ceremonial statue of the minor local god [[Pomojema]] and was guarded by a sluggish but deadly lizard creature.

[[File:LukeSkywalkerDuelsDarthVaderOnMimban-NEC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Duel on Mimban|first duel]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]]]
In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], and the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] crashed on Mimban while traveling to a conference on [[Circarpous IV]]. On Mimban, Luke and Leia encountered a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] old woman named [[Halla]]. They struck a deal with her, promising to find the Kaiburr crystal if she promised to aid them in their escape off the planet. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was also looking for the powerful Kaiburr crystal. Both in pursuit of the powerful Force relic, Skywalker and Vader dueled in the ancient Temple of Pomojema. Every movement of Skywalker was guided by the spirit of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and empowered by the crystal, so the young boy amazingly managed to hold Vader off, even managing to sever the Dark Lord's mechanical arm. Shocked, Vader tumbled down a deep pit, ending their duel. This was the [[Duel on Mimban|first battle]] between Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker. After the showdown, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were able to retrieve the Kaiburr crystal and leave Mimban.

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded Mimban from positions in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] after forming an alliance with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lords. They used the planet to [[Battle of Gyndine|attack]] nearby [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], overrunning the neighboring world. It was rumored that the Yuuzhan Vong had occupied Mimban to allow their bio-engineered [[Fire Breather]]s to fill up on swamp gas for the invasion of Gyndine.

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Mimban was originally created as an unnamed location known as Bog Planet in the earliest scripts of the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="MakingESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The planet first appeared in the [[1978]] novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', where it was given the names Mimban and Circarpous V.
